title: Issue #116: P0 — End-to-End-Laufzeitplattform: Kernel, GlobusOS, Aurora AI und A-TownChain verifizieren
content:
State: closed

## Ziel
Eine nachvollziehbare, end-to-end verifizierbare Laufzeitplattform aus ShivaCore Microkernel, GlobusOS, Aurora AI und A-TownChain herstellen.

## Architekturregeln
- Dieses Repository bleibt Integrations-, Governance- und Evidence-Control-Plane; fachliche Implementierungen erfolgen ausschließlich in den kanonischen SSOT-Repositories.
- ShivaCore bleibt ein Rust/no_std capability microkernel mit minimalem TCB.
- Aurora AI und Blockchain-/VM-/Netzwerklogik laufen als isolierte User-Space-Dienste; keine KI- oder Smart-Contract-Logik im Kernel.
- Kein Merge, Import oder grünes Einzel-Gate gilt allein als End-to-End-Nachweis.
- Nachweise müssen exakten Source-SHA, Workflow-Run, Job, Step, Exitstatus und relevante Logs referenzieren.
- Status strikt trennen: IMPLEMENTED, VERIFIED, BLOCKED, RESIDUAL.

## Umsetzungsphasen
1. **Kernel boot and safety:** UEFI/QEMU boot path, HAL, scheduler, address spaces/page tables, IPC, capability checks, object/mapping lifetime, Rust gates.
2. **GlobusOS service space:** init/service manager, lifecycle and dependencies, storage/filesystem, networking, identity, logging, shutdown/recovery.
3. **Integrated OS acceptance:** reproducible boot-to-user-space test, service health, persistence across restart, failure isolation.
4. **A-TownChain runtime:** genesis/config binding, transaction validation, canonical ATC-VM, node/P2P, consensus/finality, durable state, restart recovery, multi-node test.
5. **Aurora AI runtime:** model loading/inference, versioned model ABI, policy/capability checks, approval boundaries, audited tool invocation; no direct kernel or consensus authority.
6. **Toolchain and ABI:** versioned interface contracts, compatibility tests, reproducible artifacts, dependency and source-SHA reconciliation.
7. **Release evidence:** QEMU and hardware test matrix, security gates, recovery/update tests, exact-SHA evidence bundle and explicit residual register.

## Acceptance gates
- G0: source-of-truth and architecture ownership reconciled.
- G1: kernel build/tests and boot evidence green.
- G2: OS reaches usable user space; services start/stop/recover.
- G3: chain works locally and across multiple nodes; persistence/restart verified.
- G4: Aurora inference and tools work under deny-by-default authorization.
- G5: complete end-to-end test on a pinned set of exact source SHAs; all required gates green; residuals explicit.

## Immediate execution
- Inventory current canonical source SHAs and imported subtree SHAs; report drift, do not silently sync.
- Identify the first failing P0 gate per canonical repository and open/fix work there.
- Add an evidence row for each gate with status, SHA, run/job/step, exit code, log URL, and residual IDs.
- Do not merge this documentation PR automatically. Runtime readiness remains unverified until actual evidence passes.
